g.text: asks to scan an album cover
informs that camera permission is denied
takes a photo of the cover
sends the photo for text and web detection
returns the text on the cover, the best guess,
the matching pages and the matching images
[no usable text and no Spotify link]
informs that nothing could be read or recognised
gets the albums whose Spotify link appeared next to the cover
searches albums with each clue, most reliable first (at most 5 searches)
returns up to 10 albums per search
informs that the album was not found
shows the list of candidate albums (at most 10; just one when an album
has the same cover image or clearly matches the clues)
Network or API failures show an error
message and return to the previous screen.
The back button cancels the analysis at any time.
